# shadcn/ui Usage Patterns

## Installation of New Components

```bash
# Add components via shadcn CLI — do NOT manually create files in src/components/ui/
npx shadcn@latest add button
npx shadcn@latest add form input select dialog table toast
```

---

## cn() Utility

Use `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` for all className merging:

```typescript
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

// lib/utils.ts (auto-generated by shadcn)
// import { clsx } from 'clsx';
// import { twMerge } from 'tailwind-merge';
// export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) { return twMerge(clsx(inputs)) }

// Usage:
<div className={cn(
  'rounded-md border p-4',       // base
  isSelected && 'bg-accent',     // conditional
  className,                       // passthrough from props
)} />
```

---

## Do Not Override shadcn/ui Internals

```typescript
// ❌ Wrong: overriding internal files
// src/components/ui/button.tsx — editing line colors directly

// ✅ Correct: use variants via class-variance-authority or pass className prop
<Button className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700">Approve</Button>

// ✅ Correct: use shadcn variant system
<Button variant="destructive">Delete</Button>
<Button variant="outline">Cancel</Button>
<Button variant="ghost">View</Button>
```

---

## Table with Pagination

```tsx
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { DataTablePagination } from '@/components/shared/DataTablePagination';

const OrdersTable = ({ orders, total, page, onPageChange }) => (
  <div>
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>Order #</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Amount</TableHead>
          <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {orders.map(order => (
          <TableRow key={order.id}>
            <TableCell>{order.orderNumber}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>{formatVND(order.totalAmount)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell><StatusBadge status={order.status} /></TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
    <DataTablePagination total={total} page={page} onPageChange={onPageChange} />
  </div>
);
```

---

## Toast Notifications

```typescript
// Use sonner via shadcn/ui Toaster
import { toast } from 'sonner';

toast.success('Order created successfully');
toast.error('Failed to create order');
toast.warning('Low inventory on selected product');
toast.info('Session expires in 5 minutes');
```
